author: Kai Moreno
title: Opening a new multi-customer incident
content:
# Purpose
When two or more customers report the same unlisted symptom, Support pages the incident commander and we post a new public banner. This page is only for opening a new event.

# When to use
No public banner exists yet. Two or more customers, or our own monitors, show the same failure. Then page the commander and draft the first banner.

# When not to use
If a banner already exists for this symptom and region, do not open a second event. Do not use this page to set P0 on a customer who is reporting an already-posted event.

# Priority for the command ticket
The internal incident ticket is Sev0 or Sev1 per the severity matrix. Customer SUP tickets that arrive after the banner is up follow the already-posted page, not this page.

# Related
Severity matrix. Public banner how-to. Already-posted incidents page.
